name: std::map<Key,T,Compare,Allocator>::emplace_hint

declarations.code:
template <class... Args>

iterator emplace_hint(const_iterator hint, Args &&...args);

intro:
Inserts a new element into the container as close as possible to the position just before hint.

The constructor of the element type (value_type, that is, std::pair<const Key, T>) is called with exactly the same arguments as supplied to the function, forwarded with std::forward<Args>(args)....

No iterators or references are invalidated.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
hint

 -

 iterator to the position before which the new element will be inserted


 args

 -

 arguments to forward to the constructor of the element

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: An iterator to the inserted element, or to the element that prevented the insertion.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If an exception is thrown for any reason, this function has no effect (strong exception safety guarantee).

sections.title: Complexity
sections.text: Logarithmic in the size of the container in general, but amortized constant if the new element is inserted just before hint.
